plan.question: Does exact IQ2_S NT1 gate/up pairing improve repeated model generation on the same native binary?
plan.constants: Same native binary/model/profile/runtime/config:131072 resident INT8 context,1256 expert slots,8192 prefill,5 workers+host,pcie0,adapt0,spec4,suffix0,caches0,greedy,no token graph/no coupled draft,Q8 MTP,packed bank. Only PAIR0/1 differs; SINGLE_EXACT0,AUDIT1,CENSUS1,TIMING1 and validation/trace identical before exec.
plan.eligibility: Four official warmups then both thinking-on workloads per fresh native process. Each long request >=32768 fresh input,1024..16384 output including thinking,>=512 answer chars,normal stream/native exit,observed pair dispatch,six pinned physical CPUs and exact target census conservation. No output/hash equality requirement.
plan.decision: For each workload and each process pair use candidate/base token throughput computed from actual tokens/engine milliseconds. Judge prefill and decode separately. Faster screen: all three ratios>1 and geomean>1.01; slower screen: all<1 and geomean<1/1.01; otherwise inconclusive. Nonregression:geomean>=0.98 and every pair>=0.95. Advancement to clean comparison needs both decode workloads nonregressing,at least one faster,and both prefill workloads nonregressing. Confirm MTP classes separately in both arms:all three code acceptances>=0.60 and prose<=0.40. No speed-based stopping.
plan.stopping: Stop on first source/runtime/config/owner/fault/budget/native/request/dispatch/conservation failure. No retries,replaced samples or arm-order changes. Commit each process outcome before the next launch.
plan.limits: Counter/census/clock/parameter-validation observers are charged equally in both arms. This is an observed same-native screen,not clean speed,observer overhead,hardware saturation,task/agent quality,physical262144/session/RESTORE or adoption qualification. Two baseline-first pairs and one candidate-first pair cover both directions without exact chronology balance.
plan.retention: Keep twelve individual samples and compact format/NT/pair/clock/route/owner/fault evidence. Recover shared setup from pinned pilot Git reference. Successful logs,JIT and owner transcripts retire after each committed closed process; keep frozen generated inputs through cohort closure.
